_status: Checkpoints deleted in the 2026-08-17 cleanup, so this league starts from zero. No preparation step is needed any more: per-deck encoders removed the pretrain/freeze phase, and a deck with no live.pt starts from a freshly-initialized net (vocab.json is rewritten on demand). Run /train fresh start.
_open_meta_problem: mono_red_rally wins 85.5% of its non-mirror games against this roster (4,931/5,770 measured at 6,984 games/deck), from 74% vs mono_blue_terror up to 100% vs spy_combo, while its own mirror sits at a clean 49.6%. The other ten decks therefore spend much of training in matchups whose outcome is near-determined, where the terminal reward carries almost no gradient. Ten optimizer/architecture hypotheses for the resulting plateau were tested and all came back null. Owner's assessment (2026-08-17): mono_red_rally is implemented correctly and the gap is strategic facets the other decks' agents cannot currently express or perceive -- which is what WORK_CHECKLIST.md items 2-4 are aimed at, not another hyperparameter.
